required_capabilities.intent: Reuse stable ground-graph ingestion instead of rebuilding parsing and lineage normalization.
Reuse ranking heuristics for cross-project recommendation ordering.

existing_functionality.functionality: Canonical lineage ingestion and checksum generation for ground graph snapshots.
adoption_path: Pass source snapshot path and ingested_at timestamp from active run context.
Persist canonical output as REQ-016 evidence before planning packets are emitted.
compatibility_constraints: Input snapshot must include project_id, era_id, plan_id, phase_id, run_id, linked_project_id, relationship.
Ingestion output must preserve sorted unique lineage indexes for deterministic diffs.

existing_functionality.functionality: Ranks reuse opportunities by historical incident density and latency budgets.
adoption_path: Load ranking profile from shared-observability runbook export.
Map ranking output into strategy recommendation order.
compatibility_constraints: Ranking engine currently emits risk-weight-v1 only.
Upgrade adapter to risk-weight-v2 before production usage.
